author: bpatrick
html: Summer of Comics begins! I’m going to start cranking – I’ve got new Vivian to do as well as new My Boyfriend Smells and (yay!) Camilla Barnes and naturally more Curious.

comments.author: Standard
comments.html: I can’t wait for the summer of comics!

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.html:
Hahahahaha. The sad thing is I would probably have the same mental progression she did in this. “Should I?….Well, if it’s going to happen to someone ANYWAY…..I guess I could…..actually, it’s my duty……Of course it’s my duty……ALL HAIL ME THE SUPREME COMMANDER.” 🙂

Hooray for more Vivian, Boyfriend and Camilla! I’m glad I’m not the only one who wants more of Camilla. (Then again, EVERYone wants more of Camilla, at least in the strip).

cheers,
Phil

comments.html: As they say, “power corrupts.” Definitely true. It’s difficult for us weak and selfish humans to handle power well and be beneficial to others with it.
